chapters.heading: The work
body: The graphics belong with the Awake and Seek perfume, sharing one type system and one way of handling image.
The main poster puts the word ACTIVE at its centre, with layers of type running around the frame, then seals the whole thing inside clear packaging like an object under wrap.
points: Portrait poster and a pavement stand
Clear packaging with labels and a seal
Business cards, letterhead and a folded leaflet
A mockup set laid out on a desk

chapters.heading: Recognition
body: The set was ranked first in its group on submission, marked TOP 1 on the piece itself.
